## Description

Diesel fuel filter under OE number 23401-1220, for diesel vehicles. The source records the number and the diesel application but dimension, media and grade are recorded as reference figures. Diesel filtration protects the injection system, so a wrong element risks the pump and injectors. Our advice is to confirm the exact fuel type and whether the line needs water separation, then request the spec sheet for micron rating and water-separation efficiency. Verify the reference against the injection specification.
